title: Glossary
description: Contract for glossary.json — bilingual definitions surfaced inline via <Glossary term>. Every specialized term MUST carry both an English and an Urdu definition (Constitution III.1/III.2, FR-016). Adding a term is a data-only change.

term.description: Unique key; the specialized term as referenced by <Glossary term="...">.

definition_en.description: English definition in simple-English register (Constitution III.1).

definition_ur.description: Urdu definition in academic-plain register (Constitution III.2).
